import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 5000010;
    static final int INFINITY = 1000000000;
    static int n, m, k, v1, v2, s, t;
    static int[] distance = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_SIZE];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] nextEdge = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] to = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] v = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] cost = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int edgeIndex = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, v, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int v, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.v = v;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int from, int to_, int val, int cost_) {
        edges.add(new Edge(to_, head[from], val, cost_));
        head[from] = edgeIndex++;
        edges.add(new Edge(from, head[to_], 0, -cost_));
        head[to_] = edgeIndex++;
    }

    static boolean bellmanFord() {
        Arrays.fill(distance, INFINITY);
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        distance[s] = 0;
        visited[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            visited[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i - 1).next) {
                int y = edges.get(i - 1).to;
                int c = edges.get(i - 1).cost;
                if (distance[y] <= distance[x] + c || edges.get(i - 1).v == 0) continue;
                distance[y] = distance[x] + c;
                if (!visited[y]) {
                    visited[y] = true;
                    q.offer(y);
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[t] != INFINITY;
    }

    static int augment(int x, int flowLimit) {
        if (x == t) return flowLimit;
        visited[x] = true;
        int flowRes = flowLimit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i - 1).next) {
            int y = edges.get(i - 1).to;
            int v_ = edges.get(i - 1).v;
            if (distance[y] != distance[x] + edges.get(i - 1).cost || v_ == 0 || visited[y]) continue;
            int flow = augment(y, Math.min(flowRes, v_));
            if (flow > 0) {
                flowRes -= flow;
                edges.get(i - 1).v -= flow;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).v += flow;
                if (flowRes == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return flowLimit - flowRes;
    }

    static int minCostMaxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0, flow;
        while (bellmanFord()) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            while ((flow = augment(s, INFINITY)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += flow * distance[t];
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        s = 0;
        t = (n * 110) + 1;

        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edges.clear();
        edgeIndex = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) {
            addEdge(index(1, i), t, INFINITY, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                addEdge(index(i, j), index(i, j + 1), INFINITY, v1);
            }
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addEdge(s, index(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                addEdge(index(x, j), index(y, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
                addEdge(index(y, j), index(x, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(minCostMaxFlow());
    }

    static int index(int x, int k) {
        return x + (k - 1) * n;
    }
}
